faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the TISS Consultant - IDS recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications for the TISS Consultant - IDS recruitment is 12th September 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Consultant - IDS post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized university or an equivalent qualification to be eligible for the Consultant - IDS position at TISS.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Consultant - IDS post is 65 years. There are no specific age relaxations mentioned for any category in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Consultant - IDS position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Consultant - IDS post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 1,00,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Consultant - IDS post?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy available for the Consultant - IDS post in the Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS) recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for different categories?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/- for General/OBC candidates and Rs. 125/- for SC/ST candidates. Women candidates are exempted from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the TISS Consultant - IDS recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Consultant - IDS post will involve a Personal Interaction followed by Document Verification. Candidates need to clear both stages to be considered for the position.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The Consultant - IDS position is a contractual job. Candidates will be appointed on a contract basis for the duration of the project or as per the terms specified in the offer letter.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is recommended to download and read it thoroughly before applying.

faq.question: Q10. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the TISS Consultant - IDS recruitment must be submitted through the online mode only. The application link is available in the 'Important Links' section.
